display.purpose: Hero headlines only; Forest Teal, balanced wrap, ~52px ceiling.

headline.purpose: Section titles across site and platform.

title.purpose: Card titles, survey names, nav labels.

shadows.name: soft

shadows.name: lift

components.name: Primary Button (Signal Yellow)
components.description: The single loudest control on a screen — primary CTA, reward, wallet.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #FFCC33; color: #1C2526; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; padding: 12px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: filter .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(51,102,102,.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dark Button (Teal)
components.description: The credible teal CTA — often the true primary action on trust-forward pages.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #336666; color: #fff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, transform .18s ease; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background: #1F4F4F; } .ds-btn-dark:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(51,102,102,.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button (Outline Teal)
components.description: Quieter alternative action; white with teal outline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #fff; color: #336666; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid #336666; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(232,243,243,.4); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(51,102,102,.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface lifting off the warm canvas; warm 1px border; generous rounding.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #F1ECDB; border-radius: 22px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: #1C2526; } .ds-card-meta { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: #667085; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White field, warm border, teal focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #1C2526; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid #F1ECDB; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #667085; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #336666; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(51,102,102,.45); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Header Nav Pill
components.description: Floating translucent white pill header with blur, warm border, soft shadow.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.9); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid #F0ECD9; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -18px rgba(31,79,79,.3); padding: 10px 12px 10px 20px; } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; color: #1F4F4F; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 24px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #33635F; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #336666; } .ds-nav-link.ds-active { font-weight: 700; color: #336666; } .ds-nav-cta { background: #FFCC33; color: #1C2526; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: FAQ Accordion Row
components.description: White row with a teal + glyph that rotates to close; signature FAQ/help pattern.
components.css: .ds-acc { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #F1ECDB; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-acc-head { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 20px; background: none; border: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-acc-head > span:first-child { font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: #1C2526; } .ds-acc-plus { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 20px; color: #336666; transition: transform .2s ease; } .ds-acc[aria-expanded="true"] .ds-acc-plus { transform: rotate(45deg); }

narrative.overview: MyVoice is a survey panel repositioning away from the 'paid survey site' category and toward a trusted global research community. The visual system should feel like a neighbor you already trust — warm, human, unmistakably real — while quietly signalling that serious research infrastructure sits behind it. Warmth earns the first look; credibility earns the sign-up. A confident teal does the heavy lifting against soft warm-neutral surfaces, with a single bright signal yellow reserved for the moments that matter.
keyCharacteristics: Confident teal + warm neutrals, with yellow as a rare, high-value signal.
Generous rounding (18-28px) and soft, teal-tinted diffuse shadows.
Human warmth (real member faces, gentle motion) subordinated to trust.
Restraint: one accent, one voice, plenty of quiet surface.

rules.name: The Signal Yellow Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears on <=10% of any screen and only on things a member should act on or celebrate. If yellow is decorating, demote it to #FFF4CC or remove it.

rules.name: The No-Gray-On-Warm Rule
rules.body: Never place #667085 mute-gray body text on cream/sand/tinted surfaces; use Soft Teal #52706E instead.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: No second display or body typeface. Hierarchy comes from Plus Jakarta Sans weights (400/500/700/800). Inter is the only sanctioned companion, dense UI only.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No tiny tracked uppercase kicker above section headings; let the headline lead.

rules.name: The Teal-Tint Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is tinted with rgba(31,79,79,...) deep teal, never black or neutral gray.

dos: Do reserve Signal Yellow #FFCC33 for the primary action, rewards, and wallet moments (<=10% of a screen).
Do use Soft Teal #52706E for secondary text on warm/cream surfaces; keep Mute #667085 for white surfaces only.
Do tint every shadow with deep teal rgba(31,79,79,...).
Do build hierarchy from Plus Jakarta Sans weights, not new fonts.
Do hold WCAG 2.2 AA: 4.5:1 body contrast, visible focus, status by icon+label not color alone.
Do keep corners generous (18-28px) and surfaces quiet; let one thing per screen be loud.
donts: Don't slide back toward the survey-farm aesthetic: no flashing $$$, banner clutter, countdown pressure, or stock thumbs-up imagery.
Don't over-gamify: no confetti-on-everything, heavy mascot presence, or points theater that hides real earnings.
Don't ship the generic AI SaaS-cream template: no tiny tracked uppercase eyebrows, identical icon-card grids, or hero-metric block.
Don't over-correct into cold enterprise research gray (Ipsos/Nielsen stiffness).
Don't put mute-gray text on cream/sand; don't use gray or black shadows; don't nest cards; don't exceed a ~52px display headline.
Don't use color as the only signal for survey/reward state — always pair with an icon or label.
